I replied to Ilse in a thread in #north-team. I didn't record 25 November, because our records give a different Brackenwater renewal date.

- **The signed renewal order form** (signed 21 Nov 2025, for the term starting 1 Dec 2025) gives the renewal date as **30 November 2026**.
- **The account page** (last updated 30 Sep 2026) also says the current term ends 30 Nov 2026.
- **An older CRM note** from Feb 2026 says 31 December 2026. That doesn't match the contract either, so it looks wrong.

I couldn't find an amendment or any other record that moves the date to 25 November. I asked Ilse whether it's a new date, or an internal deadline before the 30th. Until she confirms, 30 November stays as the date on file.

The renewal date is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team. I left the contract's pricing out of the reply.
